text:
Anton Johansson is a 22-year-old rookie getting a full first look on a Red Wings blue line that has kept him in every game. The 2022 fourth-round pick from Stockholm came over after two SHL seasons with Leksand, and he's played all 21 games at about 13.5 minutes a night, with 2 goals and 5 points.

The points are a touch ahead of the chances (0.9 expected goals, 2 scored), which is normal noise for a defenseman. The five-on-five numbers are the part to watch. Detroit has only 42.5% of the expected goals, the quality of chances, with him on the ice, about 11 points worse than without him, and his minutes have slipped by almost two a night over the last ten games.

That's not a verdict on a first-year player in limited minutes, but it is the gap he has to close. He's 6-foot-4, shoots right and has a heavy shot (68th percentile in NHL Edge tracking). The question for the rest of his rookie season is whether the defensive side catches up to the size.
